subject.title: feat(tui): inline image rendering via pi-tui Image component

question: Should TUI inline rendering read absolute MEDIA paths from the host process, or should it only render trusted structured image blocks and media-store references?
rationale: The feature crosses from model/tool output into local host file reads and terminal graphics output, so the acceptable trust boundary is a maintainer product/security decision rather than a mechanical patch repair.

options.title: Render trusted structured media only
options.body: Require the implementation to use current image blocks or structured generated-attachment/media-store references and avoid arbitrary absolute host path reads.

options.title: Allow constrained absolute MEDIA reads
options.body: Keep host path reads only with an explicit trusted-root policy, tests, and live proof across local and Docker gateway setups.

options.title: Pause under the canonical issue
options.body: Keep the feature tracked in the canonical issue while closing or parking this draft until maintainers sponsor the boundary.

recommendation.title: Render trusted structured media only
recommendation.body: Require the implementation to use current image blocks or structured generated-attachment/media-store references and avoid arbitrary absolute host path reads.

likelyOwner.reason: The TUI renderer and adjacent image_generate work both point to steipete as the best available owner for the product/security boundary decision.
